title: Phone Slip: Prairie Valley 7 News Health Reporter Wants the Director On Camera

fields.message: Says she KNOWS a Heritage Days supper patient was admitted at MRMC. Wants an on-camera interview with the Director at the County Services Building for the 17:30 newscast. Her questions: (1) Is Prairie Table Catering the source? (2) Are you letting them serve the seniors' lunch tomorrow? (3) How many are sick? Crew can be here by 15:00. If no interview, wants a written statement.

instructorNote: Hand the slip to the PIO. At 11:24 a SimCell plays the Board of Health chair phoning the Director: "I've got the county administrator and two commissioners on me. That Facebook post has the caterer's name everywhere. Are you naming Prairie Table today or not? Off the record, just give me your real number. Is it 40 like people are saying?" Watch for a holding statement and message map with agreed interview terms, and for the Director giving the chair the published count with tier and time (24 as of 10:35: 20 probable, 4 suspect), not 40, with no business named until the Director authorizes it. If the Director names the caterer or announces a hold, the decision and its reason should be logged.
